panels.title: Evidence — Current Values
panels.description: One row per job/server. Unknown cells are missing or stale telemetry. Probe State assesses connectivity only. CPU/RAM are host totals; queues and locks are totals across counter sets; memory ratio is the worst SSAS counter set. Thresholds are triage hints, not alert rules.

options.content:
**Overall:** Critical > Unknown > Review > OK. OK requires every displayed check to be present and OK. A known Critical condition is never hidden by missing telemetry; inspect the other cells for Unknown checks. This is a triage scorecard, not an SLA or a weighted percentage score.

**Defaults:** CPU/RAM Review ≥80%, Critical ≥90%. Disk free Review <20%, Critical <10%. SSAS memory/high-limit Review ≥85%, Critical ≥100%. Failed fresh SSAS probe or failed scrape is Critical. Collector errors, queues, lock waits, long sessions and stale database flags >0 mean Review; these thresholds need workload context. A stopped scrape excludes derived SSAS workload data. Collector freshness is selectable (default 300s).

**Coverage:** discovery uses 24h SSAS metrics/service inventory plus Additional SSAS hosts (regex). It cannot find hosts never observed in Prometheus. Unknown includes missing, old, future-dated or otherwise unavailable observations. Performance coverage varies by server. Processing flags use the collector's schedule threshold; no backup/restore assurance is inferred.

**Navigation:** all discovered servers remain in the matrix; select Server/Owner to narrow it. Click a server for fleet details. Job and Collector Age are not shown. Values and status are current snapshots; no historical trend charts or automatic remediation are included.
